name: Kim Sang-yong
bio: Kim Sang-yong (김상용, 金尙鎔, pen-name Wolpa, 1902–1951) was a Korean poet and translator. He made his name in 1930 with a poem published in the newspaper Dong-A Ilbo, and went on publishing poems and translations under Japanese colonial rule and afterwards in the Republic of Korea.

His one collection of verse, 망향 (Manghyang, 'Longing for Home'), was published by Munjangsa in 1939. His poems are marked by a contemplative, Eastern calm, and the best known, 남으로 창을 내겠소, first appeared in the journal Munhak in 1934.

poems.title: 남으로 창을 내겠소 (Nameuro changeul naegesso)
poems.author: Kim Sang-yong
poems.text:
남(南)으로
창(窓)을 내겠소.

밭이 한참갈이
괭이로 파고
호미론 김을 매지요.

구름이 꼬인다
갈 리 있소.

새 노래는 공으로 들으랴오.

강냉이가 익걸랑
함께 와 자셔도 좋소

왜 사냐건
웃지요.
